title: Y90 Radioembolization Therapy
summary: Y90 radioembolization therapy guidance for hepatic malignancy treatment, radiation lobectomy, bridge therapy, and palliative disease control.
provenance: Imported from procedure orders PDF updated 4.15.26
reviewNotes: Confirm local Y90 activity and dosimetry workflow.
Confirm SIR-Sphere and TheraSphere lung shunt/lung dose policy.
Confirm nuclear medicine handoff and scheduling workflow.
Confirm one-month MRI liver mass and lab workflow.

items: Confirm sedation plan - patient can lie flat.

blocks.text: Hepatic malignancy treatment, bridge therapy, radiation lobectomy, or palliation.

items: Radiation lobectomy to treat tumor and induce contralateral hypertrophy.

blocks.text: High bleeding risk; hold anticoagulants/antiplatelets per policy.

items: Warfarin: hold 5 days and confirm INR <= 1.8.
IV unfractionated heparin: hold 4-6 hours and check aPTT or anti-Xa level.
Enoxaparin: hold 1 dose if prophylactic; hold 2 doses or 24 hours if therapeutic.
DOAC timing is agent-, dose-, and renal-function-specific; use the anticoagulation table.
Clopidogrel and ticagrelor: hold 5 days; prasugrel: hold 7 days.

blocks.text: Confirm indication, mapping anatomy, labs, cone-beam CT, nuclear medicine scheduling, and lung shunt thresholds.

blocks.title: Core checklist
items: Review anatomy from Y90 mapping study.

blocks.title: Lung shunt fraction from Tc-99m mapping scan
items: 10-20% - elevated; calculate predicted lung dose and potentially reduce Y90 activity.

blocks.title: TheraSphere glass microspheres
items: No percentage cutoff for TheraSphere glass microspheres; lung dose is the metric.

blocks.text: Routine orders, access recovery, anticoagulation restart, discharge, AVS, and one-month follow-up.

blocks.title: Routine orders
items: Vital signs - Every 15 minutes x 4, then every 30 minutes x 2, then every 1 hour x 4, then every 4 hours; edit to match bedrest.

blocks.title: Femoral access
items: Bedrest for 2 hours with leg flat.

blocks.title: Anticoagulation to resume
items: Warfarin: resume the day after the procedure; bridging requires individualized multidisciplinary planning.
IV unfractionated heparin: 6-8 hours after the procedure.
Apixaban, rivaroxaban, dabigatran, and edoxaban: Table 6 lists 24 hours; confirm renal function and local policy before restarting.
Clopidogrel: 6 hours after the procedure for a 75-mg dose or 24 hours for a 300-600-mg loading dose.
Ticagrelor, prasugrel, and aspirin: resume the day after the procedure.
Restart only after procedural bleeding risk is controlled; traumatic, neuraxial, multi-agent, and high-thrombosis-risk cases need individualized review.

blocks.title: Discharge
items: Discharge order with medication reconciliation prior - 2-6 hours.

blocks.title: Follow up
items: Clinic visit in 1 month with MRI liver mass and labs: CBC, INR, CMP, AFP.
